import statistics, math
vals=[215,215,208,187,197,199,209,206]
changes=[b-a for a,b in zip(vals, vals[1:])]
print(changes)
print('sample stdev', statistics.stdev(changes))
print('pop stdev', statistics.pstdev(changes))
print('half sample',1.28*statistics.stdev(changes),'2wk',1.28*statistics.stdev(changes)*math.sqrt(2))
print('median',statistics.median(vals),'mean',statistics.mean(vals))
PY"
